reviews.title: Lazada’s Deceptive Overlays and Forced Redirects
reviews.text:
I’m thoroughly fed up with how Lazada handles overlay pop-ups. Every time I open the app, I get bombarded with promotional overlays. That’s annoying enough, but what really frustrates me is that tapping the 'X' button to dismiss them doesn't even work properly.
Instead of closing the pop-up, tapping 'X' constantly redirects me to random promotion pages, flash sales, or product listings I never wanted to see in the first place. Using a close button as a hidden trap to force me into viewing ads is a cheap trick that wastes my time.
I don't have to deal with any of this hassle on Shopee. Over there, when I tap to close an ad, it actually closes without hijacking my screen. Because Shopee respects my time and doesn't force deceptive redirects on me, that’s where I usually end up checking out my orders instead. Lazada needs to fix these misleading UI overlays and respect user taps. Until when I hit 'X' it actually closes the overlay, I’ll keep taking my business to Shopee.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal Lazada user for a long time, especially during their sales events, and I’ve always appreciated the reliable service from their couriers. However, lately, my parcels seem to be constantly passed from one person to another, and after waiting for almost two weeks, the reason given is that the customer supposedly canceled the order.
While I appreciate that I can receive a full refund, the problem is that I actually need the parcel because it contains food for my pet. It’s very disappointing because there was already an estimated delivery date provided, and yet after two weeks, the package still hasn’t arrived.

P.S. To be clear, I did not cancel this order. The courier canceled the delivery, but the reason stated was that the customer canceled it. Misrepresenting the cancellation this way is unacceptable and only adds to the frustration of an already poor delivery experience.
